name: Ode to Joy — theme
source: Beethoven, Symphony No. 9, finale: the 16-bar theme, written out by hand

transcription.by: Claude, from the theme as it is usually printed
transcription.covers: melody only, AA'BA', 16 bars, in D as the symphony has it
transcription.notes: A and A' differ only in their last bar (F# E E, then E D D): the case for variants. 2026/midis/ode-to-joy.mid is an orchestral performance with humanized timing, so it is not used for comparing.
